entry.title: New: Resolution 184 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF A LATER FISCAL YEAR AND OF MORE THAN ONE FISCAL YEAR FOR MULTI-YEAR EMPLOYMENT CONTRACTS FOR THE OFFICE OF HOUSING AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into two-year employment contracts for one program oversight manager, one special program manager, and one program data manager to implement and manage the Homelessness and Housing Programs.
